title: Act No 01 of 2023   Customs and Excise Amendment
text:
Customs and Excise Duties
BELIZE:
CUSTOMS AND EXCISE DUTIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Repeal and replacement of Schedule I.

No. 1] Customs and Excise Duties 1
No. 1 of 2023
I assent,
(H.E. STUART LESLIE)
Deputy Governor-General
4th January, 2023.
AN ACT to amend the Customs and Excise Duties Act,
Chapter 48 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised
Edition 2020; to implement the Customs and Excise
Tariff and Trade Classification based on the 2022 version
of the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding
System; to implement the ninth phase of reduction
of duties in accordance with the CARIFORUM-EU
Economic Partnership Agreement; to implement
the ninth phase of reduction of duties in accordance
with the CARIFORUM-UK Economic Partnership
Agreement; to implement the first phase of reduction of
duties in accordance with the Belize/Taiwan Economic
Cooperation Agreement; and to provide for matters
connected therewith or incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 7th January, 2023).
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:

2 Customs and Excise Duties [No. 1
Short title. 1. This Act may be cited as the
CUSTOMS AND EXCISE DUTIES (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2022,
and shall be read and construed as one with the Customs
Cap. 48.
and Excise Duties Act, which is hereinafter referred to as
the principal Act.
Repeal and 2. The principal Act is amended by repealing Schedule I
replacement of and replacing it with the following, which shall be printed
Schedule I.
and published in a separate document, but which shall be
construed as and form part of the Act–
“Customs Tariff and Trade Classification”
SCHEDULE I
Upon commencement of this Act, a copy of Schedule I will be available at the Customs and Excise
Department in Belize City and at the Ministry of Finance, Belmopan.
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan
